ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_margin_adaptive_scaled_bias_v8_fixed_no_cos
ir.intuition: Same adaptive margin with nonlinear beta and bias modulation using delta_rank statistics, replacing unsupported cos with a clipped approximation based on tanh for safe runtime.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
abs_delta_rank = abs(delta_rank)
abs_delta_rank_mean = mean(abs_delta_rank) + eps
delta_rank_mean = mean(delta_rank)
delta_rank_var = mean((delta_rank - delta_rank_mean)**2) + eps
norm_var = delta_rank_var / (abs_delta_rank_mean + 0.1)
beta_mod = tanh(norm_var)**2
beta = 0.05 * exp(-3 * norm_var) * beta_mod
safe_sign = delta_rank / (abs_delta_rank + eps)
theta = delta_rank_mean * pi
cos_approx = tanh(2.0 - 0.5 * (theta - 1.57)**2)  # smooth approx of cos near theta
bias_dynamic = (bias * safe_sign / (abs_delta_rank_mean + 0.1)) * (1 + 0.3 * cos_approx)
scaled_bias = tanh(gamma * (abs_delta_rank + 0.05) / (abs_delta_rank_mean + 0.05))
margin_scale = alpha * exp(0.75 * log(clamp(abs_delta_rank_mean, min=eps)))
scaled_margin = margin * margin_scale
weighted_margin = scaled_margin - beta * delta_rank
biased_margin = weighted_margin + bias_dynamic * scaled_bias
x = clamp(biased_margin, -15, 15)
loss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(x)
weighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight
loss = sum(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    bias = float(extra.get('bias', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('bias', 0.5)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', 2.0))

    abs_delta_rank = ops.abs(delta_rank)
    abs_delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(abs_delta_rank) + eps
    delta_rank_mean = ops.mean(delta_rank)
    delta_rank_var = ops.mean(ops.mul(ops.sub(delta_rank, delta_rank_mean), ops.sub(delta_rank, delta_rank_mean))) + eps

    norm_var = ops.div(delta_rank_var, ops.add(abs_delta_rank_mean, 0.1))

    beta_mod = ops.mul(ops.tanh(norm_var), ops.tanh(norm_var))
    beta = ops.mul(0.05, ops.mul(ops.exp(ops.neg(ops.mul(3.0, norm_var))), beta_mod))

    safe_sign = ops.div(delta_rank, ops.add(abs_delta_rank, eps))

    theta = ops.mul(delta_rank_mean, 3.141592653589793)
    # Approximate cos(theta) with a smooth function using tanh to avoid unsupported ops
    cos_approx = ops.tanh(ops.sub(2.0, ops.mul(0.5, ops.mul(ops.sub(theta, 1.5707963267948966), ops.sub(theta, 1.5707963267948966)))))

    bias_dynamic = ops.mul(
        ops.div(ops.mul(bias, safe_sign), ops.add(abs_delta_rank_mean, 0.1)),
        ops.add(ops.ones_like(delta_rank_mean), ops.mul(0.3, cos_approx))
    )

    scaled_bias = ops.tanh(ops.mul(gamma, ops.div(ops.add(abs_delta_rank, 0.05), ops.add(abs_delta_rank_mean, 0.05))))

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_scale = ops.mul(alpha, ops.exp(ops.mul(0.75, ops.log(ops.clamp(abs_delta_rank_mean, min=eps)))))
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(margin, margin_scale)

    weighted_margin = ops.sub(scaled_margin, ops.mul(beta, delta_rank))
    biased_margin = ops.add(weighted_margin, ops.mul(bias_dynamic, scaled_bias))

    x = ops.clamp(biased_margin, -15.0, 15.0)

    loss_per_pair = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    return loss
